observed: Dragging the first work order to Unassigned opens "Clear <technician>'s scheduled shifts?" with Cancel, Keep Shifts and Clear Shifts - the same question as for a change of lead.
More actions > Unassign on the second work order opens the same question.
After Keep Shifts both work orders are in Unassigned, each with "<number> moved to Unassigned" and Undo, and both 8:00-12:00 shifts are still on the Schedule.
